changelog:
Initial release of memory-feedback skill introducing agent memory, pattern detection, and semi-automatic improvement proposals.

- Logs all episodes and failures from skills, storing data locally by default.
- Scans logs for repeating failure/action patterns and confidence thresholds.
- Proposes skill improvements as GitHub pull requests (human review required).
- Rate limits, storage management, and audit/report tools included.
- GITHUB_TOKEN and GitHub CLI are optional, needed only for PR workflow; local learning works without them.
summary: Agent memory and learning system. Logs actions/failures, detects patterns, proposes skill improvements via GitHub PRs. Human approval required.
